meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求用该技能做计划时，Claude会先宣告启动，然后主持一场5位对抗评审互相挑刺的辩论，只把经得起攻击的要点保留下来，再交给一个专用规划任务整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan”等触发词，或要求用最严谨的方式规划以暴露薄弱假设、盲点和过度设计时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个项目。
say.note: Claude会启动5人对抗评审流程。

say.text: 用 hpp 审查一下这份方案的薄弱点。
say.note: 评审团会攻击假设和过度设计。

say.text: 用 adversarial plan 规划这个新功能。
say.note: Claude会组织交叉批评辩论后给出计划。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', leads a 5-member hostile team that cross-critiques the plan, keeps only insights that survive, and hands them to a planner task for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says trigger words like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or asks for maximum-rigor planning that surfaces weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this project.
